answer: Payment for graded work sits in escrow until the grades clear, and any attestation set that traces back to one subnet is taxed before release, so a spiral of accounts inside one hosting range pays a penalty on every epoch it confirms. Auditors come from a rotating pool instead of the payer's list. A comet of growth in one range shows up as a lagoon of withheld balance, which is the cost an operator meets before any benefit.
